text.card: A red giant 3,320 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.93 solar masses and 20.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,450 K at its surface.
